title: Figure 21. Impact of Phase Noise Improvements on Phase Shift Encoding (constellations)
description: Four I/Q phase constellation plots with purple symbol clusters: "(a) QPSK" with widely scattered points, "(b) Low Noise QPSK", "(c) Low Noise 8PSK" and "(d) Low Noise 16-PSK" with tighter clusters at more positions. Caption: "Figure 21. The Impact of Phase Noise Improvements on Phase Shift Encoding". Text under section "3.3.3" gives data rate equation (13).
